description: This file contains Drupal migrate module API hooks, documentation, and plugin management functions related to data migration processes in Drupal.

methods.name: hook_migrate_prepare_row
methods.description: Allows adding data to a row before processing it, e.g., fetching and unserializing a variable value based on the row's format property.

methods.name: hook_migrate_MIGRATION_ID_prepare_row
methods.description: Allows adding data to a row for a specific migration ID, similar to the general prepare_row hook but targeted.

methods.name: hook_migration_plugins_alter
methods.description: Allows altering the list of discovered migration plugins, e.g., filtering out certain migrations based on tags.
